conflicts.quote: rossmann.de: 'Piroctine Olamine' vs pack back photo + Open Beauty Facts: 'Piroctone Olamine'
conflicts.resolution: Non-material retailer typo (position 5 in both, same 17-item list); pack spelling Piroctone Olamine (the correct INCI name) used.

canonicalReason: Current pack back-label photo (tier 1, barcode 4068134169129 visible in the same photo, 17 items) matches the Rossmann exact-GTIN page item for item except the 'Piroctine' typo; unchanged since the 2026-10-06 capture. Pack wins.
normalization: Split the canonical INCI on ',' (or '|' / '•' separators where the source uses them; dm renders a non-breaking hyphen as '|' inside names, e.g. 'COCO|GLUCOSIDE' = 'Coco-Glucoside'); per ingredient: trim, collapse internal whitespace, merge split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stays one item), strip trailing full stop; canonicalInci keeps the published capitalisation/asterisks; for the hash each item is lower-cased; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: Tier 1 rests on a community (Open Beauty Facts) photo of the German pack uploaded 2026-09-08, not Nick's own photo; Rossmann (brand owner) page re-read today agrees.
Not to be confused with ISANA MED Shampoo Anti Schuppen (GTIN 4305615629209) or Jeden Tag Ultra Sensitiv (4305615629223): different formulas.

Claim-INCI check: 'Panthenol und Niacinamide' both present; '0% Parfüm, Farbstoffe, Silikon' consistent with the list (no Parfum, no silicone, no colorants); 'stark gegen Schuppen' -> Piroctone Olamine present. No conflict.
Prior fingerprint ad3be55f... (', '-joined) is a different normalization; list content unchanged.
